messages:
Nora Blake: Quick idea 0: create a lightweight 'ownership lease' + a tiny handoff capsule for postmortem follow-ups. Short leases so cards don't rot. :leafy_green:

Samir Patel: Can you define "lease"? like TTL on the issue assignment?

Nora Blake: yes. defaults I propose: P0/P1 = 7 days, P2 = 14 days. while lease active owner posts an update every 48h. if no update -> followup-bot pings; if still stale at lease expiry -> escalate to team lead.

Juno Park: I like. Also propose a minimal handoff capsule that must be pasted to the issue when ownership changes. keeps context during rotation. example below.

Nora Blake: ```
handoff_capsule:
  from: "@old_owner"
  to: "@new_owner"
  date: "2026-03-10T14:00Z"
  remaining: "3 bullets max: tests, deploy, monitor"
  blockers: "none or short note"
  done_if: "error_rate < 0.05% for 24h"
```

Evan Torres: For recurrence detection, let's run a T+21d micro-scan (stack fingerprint + metric shape + endpoint entropy). if >=2 signals match -> create candidate followup and attach the similarity reason.

Samir Patel: For comms cadence during incident closure and early followups: microsync cadence of 30m until mitigated, then owner enters lease lifecycle with 48h updates. keep updates to 2-3 bullets: What changed / Next step / ETA.

Nora Blake: I sketched a slash command for followup-bot: `/followup create --lease=7d --owner=@IC --done_if="error_rate<0.05%"` which creates an epic with fields: owner, lease_days, done_if, owner_history. bot pins epic link in thread and posts 48h reminder.

followup-bot: Followup created -> FP-9001 (owner: Nora Blake). Lease: 7d. 48h reminder scheduled.

Juno Park: small governance rules: (1) owner must include a measurable success metric in the followup (no vague "done"); (2) if owner changes >2x, flag for process review; (3) IC rotation -> 2-week shifts with a 5-line IC mini-playbook for handoffs.

Samir Patel: dashboard items: open followups by lease age, followups nearing escalation, owner churn >1, recurrence candidates. this will help prioritize product/infra work.

Nora Blake: immediate tasks I volunteer for: add handoff capsule to the runbook (PR in 48h); Samir wire the followup-bot flags (spike 5d); Juno prototype recurrence micro-scan (10d); Evan add the micro-update template to the runbook (this sprint). trial on next two P1s.

Samir Patel: I'll start the bot wiring tomorrow. payload example for the bot below.

Samir Patel: ```json
{"template":"lease-compact","fields":{"lease_days":7,"owner":"@IC","done_if":"error_rate<0.05%","recurrence_scan_days":21},"post_actions":["pin_thread","create_epic"]}
```

followup-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48h lease-check for FP-9001 (owner: Nora Blake).

Nora Blake: thanks all 10! If no objections I'll open the runbook PR and the bot ticket now and kick off the 2-incident pilot. :rocket:
